batchSize.description:
`batchSize`: Defines the number of records to process in each batch. The default value
is 100 if not specified.

title:
`ResolveSensorAlertBatchJobOptions` defines the configuration options for a batch job used
to resolve sensor alerts. The primary configuration here is the batch size, which controls
how many records are processed in each batch.
name: ResolveSensorAlertBatchJobOptions
